storyCards.fact:
Madonna's "Open Your Heart" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Open Your Heart" is a song recorded by American singer Madonna from her third studio album True Blue (1986).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Open Your Heart was released in 1986.
